title: Governor of Keralam meets Prime Minister
body_text: Governor of Keralam, Shri Om Prakash Mathur met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi. The Prime Minister’s Office wrote on X; “Governor of Keralam, Shri @OmMathur_Raj met Prime Minister @narendramodi.” Governor of Keralam, Shri @OmMathur_Raj met Prime Minister @narendramodi. https://t.co/elBH0uMz7i — PMO India (@PMOIndia) November 4, 2026 ******* MJPS/SS/ST
